Messages.Author: jeroen rombouts
Messages.Body:
Let's start with the card text:

Possession [DS]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Necromancy
Move any vampire from your ash heap to your <uncontrolled> region. (S) Move
a vampire from your ash heap to your <ready> region (turn him or her face
up) and move 1 blood from the blood bank to the vampire.

and as far as I know no other errata.

Normally vamps are put in your ready region during (or is it at the end of)
your transfer phase. Because your minion phase has already ended, the vamp
cannot act.

Is this what happens when a vampire is possessed? There is nothing on the
card that says so.

Greetz,
Jeroen
